notes.title: Major Update + No Time To Loot 2025
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471394/91dfa3681fd766d6e2bccc1a41e5074bb2f35d64.png"]Major Update - Roulette Dungeon Demo 0.2.2.a
We’re part of No Time To Loot 2025! To celebrate, we’ve just launched a brand-new update for the Roulette Dungeon Demo.

Patch Notes
New Content

Special Events: Once per floor, encounter unique scenarios where you choose the outcome and gain bonuses

Pocket Mods: Added two new Pocket Mods

Visuals & UI

Complete visual overhaul of tooltips

Intro animation added when starting a run

Icons added to text for better visual clarity

Screen shake and additional effects when dealing or taking damage

Character description redesigns

Main menu received visual updates

Level visuals improved

Gameplay & Balance

Endless Mode difficulty increased

Betting options renamed:

Red/Black/No Bet → Red Wheel, Black Wheel & Neutral Wheel

Item limit raised from 20 → 30

Tutorial & Onboarding

Major changes to tutorial and onboarding flow for smoother progression.

notes.title: Major Update: Skins & Codex Update!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471394/9adb4db84c208edf4fab584b54b0d709a857b77e.png"]

Patch Notes

Added Skins to give familiar faces a fresh new look.

Added Gift Code menu to unlock exclusive skins.

The Codex now includes Pocket Mods.

Renamed Atlas to Codex for consistency.

Items are now added to the Codex once you first encounter them instead of only when picking them up.

Your last Pocket Bet is now saved between fights (used by the Repeat Bet button).

Volume settings now persist correctly between sessions.

Fixed an issue where the game could display in unsupported resolutions.

Hovering over buffs and debuffs now shows a tooltip with their effects.

Practice Mode has been removed. After careful consideration, we found it detracted from the core experience of discovering unique item combinations through regular gameplay.



If you want to actively help shape the development of Roulette Dungeon, feel free to give us some feedback on our Discord server (we also share exclusive skin codes there)! It's much appreciated! And feel free to leave a review on the demo page if you enjoyed it! <3



And don't forget to add Roulette Dungeon to your wishlist if you haven't done so already! (:



Play the Roulette Dungeon Demo here!

JOIN DISCORD - FREE SKINS CODES!

notes.title: Demo Update: More Chips + QoL Additions!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471394/d1c0fbe29f6f2c737733331b0b1562a9692bc08a.png"]
New Features:
Quick Restart Button Added After defeat, jump back into the action instantly with a new quick restart option.

Chips can now be found in the dungeon!
Discover Chips during your runs and use them to place powerful bets.

New Inventory Feature: View Your Current Wheel Anytime A new tab in the inventory lets you inspect your current wheel configuration from anywhere.

Wheel Preview Improvements You can now preview your wheel in all three bet states both in the Pocket Shop and your inventory.

Color Bets and Pocket Bets are now highlighted
These bet options will visually indicate when they're available to be placed.

Pocket Bets now have a 20-Chip limit per bet
Adds balance to high-risk strategies.

New Pocket Bet Tools

Repeat Button: Instantly repeat your previous Pocket Bets with one click.

Remove Button: Quickly remove all active Pocket Bets.

Bug fixes



If you want to actively help shape the development of Roulette Dungeon, feel free to give us some feedback on our Discord server! It's much appreciated!



And don't forget to add Roulette Dungeon to your wishlist if you haven't done so already! (:

notes.notes:

 New feature: Bet Meter! Using Chips to bet successfully fills the meter. Once it’s full, you gain a extra chips!
